theme.title: Past Meets Present

questions.prompt: Michael Jordan set a playoff scoring record against the 1986 Celtics in a loss. How many points did he score?
questions.note: 63 points, a playoff record, in a Bulls loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Michael Jordan (63)

funFacts.text: Chicago needed two overtimes to settle the record-setting game in Boston, but the Celtics held on.
Charles Oakley led the Bulls on the glass that night, pulling down fourteen rebounds.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Charles Oakley (14)

funFacts.text: Boston Garden drew a crowd of 14,890 for that historic first-round playoff game.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston Garden 14,890

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 1999–2000 Lakers win?

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: They posted winning streaks of 11, 16, and 19 en route to a 67–15 record

funFacts.text: The Lakers hired Phil Jackson shortly after the Spurs swept them out of the previous postseason.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Twenty-four days after being swept by the eventual league champion, the Lakers signed Phil Jackson as head coach

funFacts.text: Jackson installed the triangle offense around Shaquille O'Neal and Kobe Bryant, borrowing the system from his Bulls years.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Jackson, famous for coaching Michael Jordan and the six-time champion Chicago Bulls, would build his triangle offense

funFacts.text: This was the Lakers' inaugural season playing home games at Staples Center, their newly opened arena.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Another huge change for the Lakers was that it was their inaugural season at the Staples Center

questions.prompt: Boston routed Atlanta 132–99 in the 1986 East semifinals. How many points did the Hawks score in the third quarter?
questions.note: Six, as Boston won the quarter 36–6.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston outscored Atlanta 36–6 in the third quarter in route to a 132–99 victory.

funFacts.text: Before that Hawks blowout, Boston had already swept Michael Jordan's Bulls in the first round.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Boston needed just three games to defeat the Chicago Bulls in the first round

funFacts.text: The Celtics subsequently swept Milwaukee to reach the championship round without a conference-finals loss.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: in the conference finals, Boston swept the Milwaukee Bucks in four games

funFacts.text: That season's championship series marked the first official use of the 'NBA Finals' branding.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: this series marked the first time the "NBA Finals" branding was officially used

questions.prompt: In the bubble's wild 2020 Jazz–Nuggets opening playoff game, how many points did Donovan Mitchell score?
questions.context: Donovan Mitchell · Jazz vs Nuggets · 2020 bubble
questions.note: 57 points in an overtime loss. It began a blistering playoff scoring duel with Jamal Murray.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: On August 17, 2020, Mitchell scored 57 points in a 125–135 overtime loss to the Nuggets

funFacts.text: Utah lost that opener in overtime.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Mitchell scored 57 points in a 125–135 overtime loss to the Nuggets

funFacts.text: He scored 51 more points in another game six days later.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Six days later, he scored 51 points

funFacts.text: His opener ranked third-highest in playoff scoring history at the time.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
